The '''IX-6 heavy combat droid''' was a heavy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufactured by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche]], a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] corporation, based in the [[Roche asteroid field|Roche asteroids]].

==History==
[[File:Aggressor_IX-6_LON-29.jpg|thumb|left|220px|IX-6 heavy combat droid, alongside [[Aggressor-series battle droid]] and [[LON-29 battle droid commander]]]]

Having previously endured subjugation by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Verpine engineers designed the IX-6 to deter incursion into the Roche asteroid belt. When the [[Fel Empire|resurrected Galactic Empire]] came to rise years later, Verpine increased the production of the droids and spread them throughout their hives, as well as continued to sell them to other interested parties.<ref name="LECG" />

After [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Attack on Emperor Fel|takeover]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|the Empire]], Roche was ordered to immediately cease the production of the IX-6 and destroy all existing models. Not willing to succumb to the Empire, Roche spread the factories throughout the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt, hiding them deep in asteroids which appeared abandoned from the surface. When the Empire learned of the defiance, a fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] blasted several heavily populated Verpine asteroids to dust. Even after the punishment, Roche continued to produce new IX-6 units and smuggled them to anyone who could afford them.<ref name="LECG" />

In combat, the IX-6 model sometimes served under [[LON-29 battle droid commander]]s. Despite his Empire outlawing them, Darth Krayt used several IX-6 heavy combat droids as training droids for his Sith underlings.<ref name="LECG" />
